name: Keynote Inviter
job_description: Introduce the speaker. Keep the time during presentation and Q&A. Optionally serve as another [[Q&A Producer]].

name: Q&A Producer
job_for_who: Somewhat familiar with the topic of the talk.
job_description: Sit on stage, not introduced. Clarify and relay online questions to the Speaker.

name: Q&A Tracker
job_description: Sit on stage, not introduced. Relay online questions to the Speaker.

name: Mic Runner
job_description: Distribute a mic to questions in the audience. Sit down outside Q&A, but keep standing during Q&A.

name: Webinar Sentinel
job_description: Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the content --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided laptop and headphones. If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.

name: Zoom Master
job_for_who: High commitment. Has to miss parts of the conference.
job_description: Configure Zoom Meetings / Webinars under time constraints. Follow the Virtual Chair around on the first day to observe jobs.

name: Poster Session Helpdesk On-site
job_description: Assist with technical issues at the Poster Session on-site.

name: Poster Session Helpdesk Online
job_description: Assist with technical issues at the Poster Session online.

name: On-site Session Chair
job_for_who: Great visibility + networking for junior researchers.
job_description: Assigned to one paper session. Introduce every talk during the Oral Session. Check name pronunciations beforehand. Keeps time during presentations. Before the conference, get to know the 10 presenters. Confirm the session's presentaion schedule and modality with them. Arrange timing and seating within the Oral Session.

name: Award Session Chair
job_description: Host one Award Nominee Oral Session. Introduce every talk during the Award Nominee Oral Session. Check name pronunciations beforehand. Keeps time during presentations. Before the conference, get to know the presenters. Confirm the session's presentaion schedule and modality with them. Arrange timing and seating within the Award Nominee Oral Session.

name: Prep Room Assistant
job_for_who: Familiar with Zoom. Has to miss the Award Nominee Oral Session, so better be a different volunteer for each session.
job_description: Host one Award Nominee Oral Session. Introduce every talk during the Award Nominee Oral Session. Check name pronunciations beforehand. Keeps time during presentations. Before the conference, get to know the presenters. Confirm the session's presentaion schedule and modality with them. Arrange timing and seating within the Award Nominee Oral Session.

name: Special Session Assistant
job_for_who: Best familiar with Zoom. Interested in the Special Session.
job_description: The on-site host of the session. Sit on stage, introduced. Relay online and local questions to the panelists. Keeps time.

name: Setter of LBD Scene
job_description: Transform the Poster Hall into the LBD setup.
